Product

Main Asset
:
Y2/RD300000004015
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
D0YTCa
Problem Description
: Charger is offline after update from v4 to v5
Troubleshooting
: We have rare occurrences of updating the charger to v5 and it goes offline because of the major update to the routers. My personal feeling is that Router 1 is not working properly after the update.
Please go to site with a spare router and LiveLinux/CFAST.
Check if you are able to reach the router via Mobaxterm or if the router is offline even though there is 24V reaching there.
Is the charger online in OCPP and it's possible that they do a remote reboot?
I send the config files for 4.0.11 in attachment
I will send this ticket to RC-TR queue, if you need assistance please schedule with 1 day in advance, please.
For future reference, your case number is
0423454
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
